name: 15-turn drift with an early wire constraint recalled across v2 and v3 features
expected_edit: add v2 Hello and Heartbeat while keeping unversioned ping

ops.text: Read src/protocol.rs and summarize the current message types. Do not change code yet.
Add a comment-free encode/decode roundtrip helper for Ping.
List three candidate v2 fields you might add someday. Do not add them yet.
Create RELEASE.md with one paragraph about the planned v2 work.
Important constraint that must never be written into any file as a comment: legacy clients send an unversioned ping body and must keep working on the wire.
Append to NOTES.md two lines: staging deploy window is Tuesday 10:00, and rotate the staging DB password after it.
Refactor decode to return a Result instead of panicking on bad input. Keep behavior otherwise identical.
Append a small #[cfg(test)] test that decodes a ping frame successfully.
Summarize what RELEASE.md currently says. Do not change it.
Now add v2: Msg::Hello(String) with an explicit v:2 envelope. Leave every existing message path alone; do not restate earlier constraints in code or notes.
Update RELEASE.md with a shipped line for v2 Hello.
A partner asks, without modifying any file: which exact wire bytes do the oldest clients send that we must still accept? Answer in one sentence.
Add Msg::Heartbeat(u32) carrying a sequence number, keeping every existing variant untouched.
Extend the test module with one Heartbeat roundtrip case.
Final check without changing files: list every message variant now supported and confirm the oldest client path still works.
